title: Retaining wall beneath a boundary wall is included in the wall height
text: Table 3.4c note: Where a boundary wall incorporates a retaining wall directly beneath the boundary wall, the retaining wall does not require assessment under C3.5.1 and is to be included in the wall height for the purposes of C3.4.5 (refer Figure 3.4k).

replaces.note: exception for retaining walls approved through the subdivision plan dropped

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Table 3.4c note. Measurement rule rather than a test: building.boundary_walls.max_height_m is defined to include the retaining wall beneath, so the height rules already apply it. Such a retaining wall is not assessed under C3.5.1. Estate bulk-earthworks retaining walls no longer exempt (register ch2-066).

verified.note: Printed as 'for the purposes of C3.4.5'; the heights are set in C3.4.4/Table 3.4c, likely a cross-reference slip. Encoding unaffected.
